t.why: A flag of convenience with one of the world's largest ship registries.
t.rel: Founded by freed enslaved people who returned from the United States, it has historically close ties with America. It has kept the peace since two civil wars.
t.korea: Many ships built in Korean shipyards are registered under the Liberian flag. They count as exports to Liberia, which is why it ranks high among Korea's export destinations.
t.know: Because it was founded by Black Americans freed in the 19th century, its flag resembles the Stars and Stripes.
t.etext: It sells iron ore, gold, rubber and timber. Its flag-of-convenience ship registry is the largest in the world.
